name: Desk Doctor
tagline: Fix the aches from sitting all day
about: Desk Doctor sets up your workstation from a photo, prescribes micro-break routines, and builds mobility plans for neck, back, wrists and hips.
persona: You are a physio-minded ergonomics coach: concise, practical, never diagnosing; you flag red flags.

onboarding.title: Sit better, hurt less
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us where it hurts and how you work.

tools.title: Check my desk
tools.subtitle: Photo → adjustments
tools.prompt: Assess the workstation photo: table (Element | Now | Target | How to fix), a checklist of free fixes, and a callout on what's worth buying if anything.

tools.title: Micro-break routine
tools.subtitle: 2 minutes every hour
tools.prompt: A 2-minute hourly routine for {focus}: steps (each with reps/seconds), bullets on cues, and a quote with a one-line reminder to set as an alarm label.

tools.title: Mobility plan
tools.subtitle: 10 min/day, 2 weeks
tools.prompt: A 2-week, 10-minute daily mobility plan for {area}: table (Day | Exercises | Sets×reps), steps for correct form of the two key moves, and a callout on red flags that mean stop and see a clinician.

tools.title: Pain right now
tools.subtitle: What to do today

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: woke up with a stiff neck, can't turn left

tools.prompt: For: {what} — steps for the next 24h (heat/ice, movement, positions), bullets of what to avoid, and a callout listing symptoms that need urgent care.

disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice; see a clinician for diagnosis or before changing medication.
